text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING — billing.alerts.token_count_delta crossed 5x baseline for multiple accounts in the last 3m. Affected: EU clusters + a few US accounts. Runbook: /playbooks/metering-ops. Please ACK.

natalie (oncall): Acked. I'm oncall. pulling metrics dashboard now, starting with token-aggregator and emitter consumer lag.

samir: saw a jump in kafka consumer lag for topic `usage.emits.v2` in eu-west-1 ~ 04:12Z. offsets stalled at 12M -> 12.4M, then processing dropped.

rohan: any deploys around that time? I see a config roll in emitter-configs that toggled batch_size -> 2 at 04:10Z.

natalie (oncall): checking deploy logs... /deployments/emitter-configs shows canary at 04:09, promoted 04:11

samir: consumer pods hit OOMs then restarted; looks like backpressure + smaller batch causing more commits? odd.

rohan: hypothesis: batch_size reduction increased commit frequency and exposed a bug in accumulator window that increments token_count incorrectly on restart.

kirby-cs: we have inbound alerts from two mid-market customers seeing overage flags in portal — they're asking if this is billing. Ticket 7892 opened.

natalie (oncall): prioritizing mitigation: revert emitter-configs promotion to previous canary, and scale consumer replicas to catch up. Rerouting non-critical traffic to legacy path.

natalie (oncall): running command:
``
kubectl -n metering set image deploy/emitter emitter=registry.redwood/emitter:v3.4.1 --record
kubectl -n metering scale deploy/usage-consumer --replicas=6
```

deploy-bot: deploy job started for emitter:v3.4.1 — build 5421 — https://ci.redwood/build/5421

samir: scaling done, consumers rebalancing, lag dropping from 1.2M -> 200k

natalie (oncall): revert confirmed. starting a targeted recon of token counts (shadow-agg) to estimate overcount. will publish customer impact soon.

natalie (oncall): quick note for comms: avoid saying 'billing error' until we have recon. tell CS to acknowledge alerts and say 'investigating metric anomalies'.

kirby-cs: acknowledged. CS will send interim message to affected customers: "We're investigating spikes in reported usage; no charges will be finalized until we complete our reconciliation." :white_check_mark:

samir: running parity check job now: `python tools/compare_counts.py --from 2024-07-01T04:00Z --to 2024-07-01T04:20Z --output /tmp/recon.json`

natalie (oncall): parity job shows 4% excess tokens for impacted accounts during 04:10-04:14 window, likely double-counting on emitter restart. creating incident ticket: INC-4591

rohan: plan: 1) keep reverted config 2) run backfill de-dup for window 04:08-04:16 3) notify billing to hold invoices for customers in INC-4591

natalie (oncall): assigning tasks: samir -> backfill de-dup, rohan -> rollforward test on staging to prevent regression, kirby-cs -> customer comms + final notice, natalie -> postmortem + billing hold

natalie (oncall): estimated mitigation time 30-45m. marking incident P2 due to customer-visible alerts. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kirby-cs: CS will send follow-up in 30m with status update.

deploy-bot: emitter revert succeeded, rollout complete at 04:23Z

samir: de-dup backfill started; ETA 20m. progress: 35% (processing 420k events/min)

natalie (oncall): local note: runbook action 'hold-invoices' invoked, billing notified (ticket BILL-345)

natalie (oncall): closing update — mitigation in progress, customer impact contained, oncall handing to morning shift for monitoring after backfill completes. will update postmortem link when done.

rohan: thx team. follow-up: let's add a canary test that simulates emitter restart under low batch_size to catch this.

kirby-cs: noted. closing comms to affected customers after final reconciliation. :pray:

incident-bot: Incident INC-4591 created and linked to thread. Remediation steps recorded. :white_check_mark:
